text: Based on the evidence from NASA FIRMS, there were no thermal anomaly detections within the asset boundary during the period from 2026-09-23 to 2026-10-23. All relevant sensors (VIIRS_SNPP, VIIRS_NOAA20, VIIRS_NOAA21, and MODIS) covered the asset every day of this period. However, it's important to note that small, short, cool, or cloud-obscured fires may not have been detected. Therefore, while no fires were detected, the possibility of undetected small fires cannot be ruled out.
